descSections.overview: A Blocker wall that stalls the rival, then @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] clears the field and steals two Gigs at a time. @[Mox Inciters] forces the rival to attack into your Blockers, @[Live with the Aftermath] removes a Unit while you have little to lose, and @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] drops Gear onto Units at Quick speed.
descSections.early:
Aim is a field of Blockers: @[Mox Inciters], @[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler] and @[Mandibular Upgrade] on anything.
@[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie] draws a card whenever a Blue Unit brings a Gig down to 1, so leave a Gig at 2 or 3 for it instead of spending @[Trust No One] on every die.
Sell @[Bootleg Black Sapphire Show|Bootleg] and the extra @[Floor It] first; @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] is a sell until the fixer area empties.
With @[Kerry Eurodyne: Axe, Attitude, Audience|Kerry] face-up, reroll any roll-in that is not a 1 or the top value.
descSections.mid:
Aim is to make the rival attack on your terms: @[Mox Inciters] picks the Unit that must attack, a ready Blocker takes the hit, and @[Floor It] at Quick speed turns a close fight.
Look for @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] with @[Mandibular Upgrade] or @[Zetatech Faceplate] during the rival's attack to make a surprise Blocker or win the fight.
@[Live with the Aftermath] is best when your only Unit is a spent Blocker that already did its job.
@[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] replays @[Trust No One], @[Live with the Aftermath] or @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] from the trash for free.
descSections.late:
Aim is @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] with a spare Program in hand: a Unit goes to the bottom of their deck on play and another on each attack, and the attack takes two Gigs.
@[Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom|Jackie Welles] wants even Gigs; @[Zetatech Faceplate] nudges a Gig by 1 before the attack.
@[Adrenaline Converter] lets @[Rockn' Rockerboy] or @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] attack the turn they land when you are 2 Gigs behind.
@[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] at 1 €$ is draw 2 every turn once the fixer area is empty.
descSections.combos:
@[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] - the finisher. Every Program in hand is another rival Unit sent to the bottom of their deck.
@[Mox Inciters] - forces the attack you want, into @[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler] or a @[Mandibular Upgrade] Blocker.
@[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] + @[Mandibular Upgrade] - a Blocker out of nowhere during the rival's attack.
@[Live with the Aftermath] - one-sided removal while your field is empty or holds only a spent Blocker.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a hand with a Blocker Unit, a 1-cost Program and a Gear. @[Mox Inciters], @[Trust No One] and @[Mandibular Upgrade] is the ideal shape.
A hand of only @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide], @[Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom|Jackie Welles] and @[Bootleg Black Sapphire Show|Bootleg] is too slow and should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Mandibular Upgrade] or @[Trust No One] for the first turn with a Call, and @[Mox Inciters] or @[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler] to follow.
High-cost Units in the opening hand are not ideal when only one Legend is ready.
descSections.mulliganSecond:
Look for a Blocker that can be out before the rival's first attack: @[Mox Inciters] or @[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler] plus a Call.
@[Floor It] in hand is worth keeping for the first fight.
descSections.notes:
@[Live with the Aftermath] costs you a Unit too, so play it while your field is empty or holds a spent Blocker.
Keep one Program in hand for @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] rather than selling it.
@[Viktor Vektor: Drop Your Illusions|Viktor Vektor] makes the first Cyberware each turn cost 1.

descSections.overview: A Control deck where every Braindance Program is both removal and a power boost through @[Judy Álvarez: Braindance Maestro|Judy]. Cheap draw Programs fuel min Gigs, @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] replays the best Program from the trash, and @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] or @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] send the rival's Units to the bottom of their deck.
descSections.early:
Aim is a d4 at 1 and then a value-pair. @[Trust No One] and @[Peace Offering] get there and draw on the way.
@[Delamain: Rideshare AI|Delamain] is the early play when the hand is thin; @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy] when it is not.
Sell the extra @[Floor It] and @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] first. @[Les Élémens] is a sell only when @[Pyramid Song] and @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] are already in hand.
Spend @[Judy Álvarez: Braindance Maestro|Judy] for a Program off the top whenever the Eddie is not needed.
descSections.mid:
Aim is to answer each attacker the turn it lands: @[Chrome Reverie] locks it, @[Pyramid Song] shrinks it or bottom-decks it, @[Memory Relapse] spends it and keeps it spent.
Look for @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] with a Program already in the trash: a free @[Pyramid Song] or @[Chrome Reverie] plus a Blocker.
Stack Braindance Programs in one turn so @[Judy Álvarez: Braindance Maestro|Judy] turns @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy] into a Unit that wins its fight or steals.
descSections.late:
Aim is @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] with Programs to spare: a Unit to the bottom on play, another on each attack, two Gigs per steal.
@[Les Élémens] and @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] clear what is left so the cheap Units can steal.
@[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] is draw 2 for 1 once the fixer area is empty.
Steal low Gigs and keep yours at 1; @[Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor|Hanako] draws for every value-pair and the swap can build one.
descSections.combos:
@[Judy Álvarez: Braindance Maestro|Judy] - every Braindance Program is +1 power, so several in one turn let a small Unit win a fight or push through.
@[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] - a free Program from the trash and a Blocker on one card.
@[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] - the finisher; Programs in hand become bottom-decked rival Units.
@[Trust No One] + @[Peace Offering] - min Gigs and value-pairs that feed @[Three Mouths, One Desire], @[Pyramid Song] and @[Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor|Hanako].
descSections.mulligan:
Keep two or three cheap Programs with a cheap Unit or one removal Program.
A hand of @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide], @[Les Élémens] and @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] with no 1-cost Program should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Trust No One] with a Call on the first turn, then @[Delamain: Rideshare AI|Delamain] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire].
High-cost cards in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond:
Look for @[Trust No One] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire] plus an answer to the first attacker: @[Floor It], @[Chrome Reverie] or @[Pyramid Song].
One @[Les Élémens] is fine when two cheap plays carry you to it.
descSections.notes:
@[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] only bottom-decks unequipped Units; Gear-heavy targets go to @[Les Élémens] or @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide].
@[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie] triggers on Blue Units only: @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy], @[Delamain: Rideshare AI|Delamain], @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy], @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] and @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide].
With many cards in hand, sell the second copy of a removal Program rather than a draw Program.

descSections.overview: The BBG shell tuned for the mirror: the usual Program control plus @[MaxTac AV] and @[NetWatch Netdriver], so the deck has bodies that survive the rival's removal and draws more than they do. Wins by keeping their field empty and stealing with @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] and @[MaxTac AV].
descSections.early:
Aim is a d4 at 1 and a value-pair: @[Trust No One] and @[Peace Offering].
@[NetWatch Netdriver] on a face-up Legend early is a card every turn for the Eddie you were spending anyway.
Sell the extra @[Floor It] and one @[Les Élémens] first; keep @[Take Control] for the first attack.
descSections.mid:
Aim is to remove whatever they commit: @[Pyramid Song] and @[Les Élémens] on single Units, @[Chrome Reverie] when a lock is enough.
@[MaxTac AV] is the body that lives through @[Pyramid Song] and a Towerfall; a @[NetWatch Netdriver] on it also keeps their Maman Brigitte off it.
Look for @[Valentino Street Racer] with @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] or @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] to attack the turn they land.
Spend @[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] for the discount when the Program is expensive, or to replay @[Les Élémens] or @[Pyramid Song] from the trash.
descSections.late:
Aim is @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] attacking with a value-pair so @[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] and @[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie] ready and Alt can be used twice in one turn.
@[MaxTac AV]'s swap takes their best Gig or builds a value-pair for @[Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor|Hanako].
@[Take Control] blanks their steal when the game comes down to one Gig.
Steal their low Gigs and keep yours at 1 so the Program discount stays high.
descSections.combos:
@[MaxTac AV] + @[NetWatch Netdriver] - an 8-power body their removal cannot reach cleanly, drawing a card on every attack.
@[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] - with a value-pair readies @[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] and @[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie]; two Alt uses in a turn is the deck's biggest swing.
@[Take Control] - the mirror's best Quick card; their one steal a turn becomes none.
@[Trust No One] + @[Peace Offering] - the min Gigs and value-pairs everything else runs on.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep cheap Programs with a Unit or a @[NetWatch Netdriver].
A hand of @[Les Élémens], @[MaxTac AV] and @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] with no 1-cost Program should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Trust No One] and a Call, then @[NetWatch Netdriver] on the face-up Legend or @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy].
High-cost cards in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond:
Look for @[Take Control] or @[Floor It] for their first attack, plus @[Trust No One] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire].
@[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] is a fine keep as the first Blocker.
descSections.notes:
@[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] only hits unequipped Units; in the mirror, their Gear-equipped Unit needs @[Les Élémens].
The rival's Towerfall is strongest when they have less Street Cred, so avoid handing them a low Gig through @[MaxTac AV]'s swap.
@[Valentino Street Racer] reaches Units with cost 5 or less, which covers everything here except @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide].

descSections.overview: The @[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] Program shell with more bodies. @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro], @[Psycho Squad] and @[Mox Inciters] start stealing earlier while @[Towerfall] and @[Les Élémens] keep the rival's field empty. Min Gigs make the Programs cheap and keep Street Cred low for @[Towerfall].
descSections.early:
Aim is a d4 at 1 and then a value-pair with @[Trust No One] and @[Peace Offering].
Get a body down early: @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy] or @[Mox Inciters] as a Blocker.
Sell the extra @[Floor It] first, then @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] until the fixer area empties.
@[Chrome Reverie] with a min Gig is a free Call and a lock on their first attacker.
descSections.mid:
Aim is one big @[Towerfall] turn: spend @[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] for the discount while your Street Cred is below theirs.
Against one large Unit, look for @[Floor It] and @[Pyramid Song] in the same turn as @[Towerfall].
@[Mox Inciters] makes a Unit attack into @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] or itself; @[Floor It] at Quick speed before the fight makes it a win.
Look for @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] with a value-pair: the attack readies Alt and @[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie] for a second Alt use.
descSections.late:
Aim is to attack the Gig area every turn with @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro], @[Psycho Squad] and the small Units once the field is clear.
@[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] replays @[Towerfall] or @[Les Élémens] from the trash when they rebuild.
Steal their low Gigs and keep yours at 1; low Street Cred keeps @[Towerfall] at full strength and only the count matters.
@[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] at 1 €$ is draw 2 every turn late.
descSections.combos:
@[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] - cheaper Programs from min Gigs and a replay from the trash.
@[Towerfall] - with lower Street Cred it clears everything at 5 power or less.
@[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] - the attacker that readies Alt and @[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie].
@[Mox Inciters] - picks the fight; @[Floor It] wins it.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep @[Trust No One] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire] with a cheap Unit and one answer.
Two or more of @[Towerfall], @[Les Élémens] and @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] in one hand should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Trust No One] and a Call, then @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy] or @[Mox Inciters].
High-cost cards in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Mox Inciters] or @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] as the first Blocker, plus @[Trust No One] and @[Floor It] or @[Chrome Reverie].
descSections.notes:
Keep the d4 at 1; @[Pyramid Song] checks the d4 specifically.
@[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] only bottom-decks unequipped Units.
@[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie] triggers on Blue Units only, so @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] does not draw through it.

descSections.overview: A Midrange deck that pumps its own Gigs to 8 and above, then cashes them in: @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] gets cheap, @[Industrial Assembly] draws, and @[Over the Edge] kills anything once the d20 is high. @[Animals Wrecker] steals two Gigs a turn and @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] replays the cheap Units from the trash.
descSections.early:
Aim is a Blocker and a Gig at 8 or more. @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] holds the field; @[Industrial Assembly] and @[Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid|Dexter]'s Spend push a Gig up.
@[Mantis Blades] on the Blocker turns a chump block into a won fight.
Sell @[Detonate] when they show no Gear, and the extra @[Zetatech Faceplate].
Call @[V: Streetkid|V] when @[Bonnie and Clyde] or @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] is missing; the trash is the second hand.
descSections.mid:
Aim is to trade their Units for your Programs: @[Bonnie and Clyde] on anything at 4 power or less, @[Over the Edge] as the d20 climbs, @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] while @[Animals Wrecker] is on the field.
Look for @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] with @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] in the trash: a free Unit that attacks a spent Unit the same turn.
@[Offduty Malfini] spends their best ready Unit so your attackers can hit it.
@[Muamar Reyes: El Capitán|Muamar Reyes]'s Call lets a Blocker take the hit and survive the fight.
descSections.late:
Aim is two steals a turn: @[Animals Wrecker] with @[Mantis Blades] or @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori] on it, with @[6th Street Recruits] turning any stolen d6 into a bigger Gig.
@[Over the Edge] with the d20 at 15 or more defeats anything they play.
Keep @[Augmented Negotiators] ready as the Blocker that also strips their hand.
Once the fixer area is empty, @[Over the Edge] and @[Bonnie and Clyde] clear the last Blocker for the final steal.
descSections.combos:
@[Animals Wrecker] + @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] - with a 10-power Unit on the field, Carnage defeats almost anything, and 8+ Gigs make it cheap.
@[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] - a free Unit from the trash that attacks immediately, and a card when an ARASAKA Unit is defeated.
@[Industrial Assembly] + @[Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid|Dexter] - the Gig pump that turns on everything else.
@[Over the Edge] - the late game answer to any Unit.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a Blocker, a cheap Gear and one Gig pump or removal Program.
A hand of @[Animals Wrecker], @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] and @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] with nothing under 4 should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Industrial Assembly] or @[Mantis Blades] with a Call on the first turn, then @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout].
High-cost Units in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] ready before their first attack, plus @[Bonnie and Clyde] for whatever they lead with.
descSections.sideboard:
@[V: Roamer of the Badlands|V Roamer] in for @[Offduty Malfini] against slow decks; every steal grows a Gig and draws.
@[Royce: Don't Call Me Simon|Royce] in for @[Detonate] against small Units and Blockers.
@[Heywood Ripperdoc] in for @[Detonate] against Gear decks that put Gear on Legends.
descSections.notes:
@[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] gets a card back from the trash whenever they swap or adjust your Gigs; against Gig-swapping Legends it is the first Unit to play.
@[Bonnie and Clyde] defeats two Units when they are 2 Gigs ahead, so it is best held while behind.
@[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] compares power, not cost; a @[Mantis Blades] on your biggest Unit widens what it can hit.

descSections.overview: A Gear deck: cheap Cyberware on cheap Units, played at Quick speed through @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] so fights are won in the React Step. @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] with @[Gorilla Arms] is the finisher: win a fight, ready, then take two Gigs.
descSections.early:
Aim is a Unit with Gear by the second turn: @[Swordwise Huscle] or @[Secondhand Bombus] with @[Mantis Blades] or @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori].
@[Swordwise Huscle] with @[Mantis Blades] draws on every attack.
Sell @[Bootleg Black Sapphire Show|Bootleg] early and @[Live with the Aftermath] when your field is the bigger one.
Hold one cheap Gear for @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] during their attack.
descSections.mid:
Aim is to win fights, not just steal: @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori] draws on every win, @[Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid|Dexter]'s Call adds 2 power, @[Muamar Reyes: El Capitán|Muamar Reyes]'s Call makes a Unit survive its fight.
Look for @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] plus @[Mantis Blades] on a Blocker in the React Step so their attacker dies.
@[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] is the Blocker that beats Legends; @[Secondhand Bombus] is the one you do not mind losing.
@[Live with the Aftermath] trades a @[Secondhand Bombus] for a Unit of theirs; strongest when they have only one.
descSections.late:
Aim is @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] with @[Gorilla Arms]: win a fight against a spent Unit, ready, then take two Gigs from the Gig area.
@[Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom|Jackie Welles] with even Gigs is another two-Gig attacker; @[Zetatech Faceplate] sets the values up.
@[Adrenaline Converter] lets a fresh Unit attack when they are 2 Gigs ahead.
@[Over the Edge] with a high d20 removes the last Blocker.
descSections.combos:
@[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] + @[Gorilla Arms] - win, ready, steal two.
@[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] + @[Mantis Blades] - a free Gear in the React Step that flips a fight.
@[Swordwise Huscle] + any 2-power Gear - a 3-cost Unit that draws every time it attacks.
@[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori] - the deck's card draw; put it on the Unit that fights the most.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep two cheap Units and two cheap Gear.
A hand with no Unit under 4, or Gear with nothing to equip, should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Mantis Blades] or @[Secondhand Bombus] with a Call on the first turn and @[Swordwise Huscle] after.
@[Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom|Jackie Welles] and @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] or @[Secondhand Bombus] plus a Gear to answer their first attacker in the React Step.
descSections.notes:
@[Gorilla Arms] takes a Gig whose value you do not already hold, so vary your own Gig values with @[Zetatech Faceplate].
@[6th Street Recruits] grows a Gig by 6 whenever a stolen Gig is a d6; take their d6 first when it is there.
@[Muamar Reyes: El Capitán|Muamar Reyes]'s Spend adjusts a Gig by 1 for the @[Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom|Jackie Welles] even count.

descSections.overview: The @[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] Program-control deck with three @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] as the attacker. Min Gigs make Programs cheap, give @[Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor|Hanako] and Pepe their value-pairs and keep Street Cred low for @[Towerfall]; @[Memory Relapse] and @[Chrome Reverie] hold the rival still in between.
descSections.early:
Aim is a d4 at 1 and a value-pair of min Gigs: @[Trust No One] then @[Peace Offering].
Call every turn; @[Chrome Reverie] with a min Gig does it for free while locking their first attacker.
Sell the extra @[Floor It] and @[Take Control] first, then @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] until the fixer area empties.
@[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy] is the early body that attacks on any Program turn.
descSections.mid:
Aim is a clean @[Towerfall] with Street Cred below theirs; spend @[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] for the discount first.
@[Memory Relapse] spends their best Unit and keeps it spent, so @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] can attack it; with even Street Cred it draws too.
Single targets go to @[Les Élémens], @[Pyramid Song] or @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte].
Look for @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] attacking with a value-pair: Alt and @[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie] ready and Alt replays @[Towerfall] from the trash the same turn.
descSections.late:
Aim is three @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] attacks a turn into an empty field; every attack readies the Legends for more Eddies or another Alt use.
@[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] at 1 €$ is draw 2 or a lock on their only attacker.
Steal their low Gigs and keep yours at 1; low Street Cred keeps @[Towerfall] at full strength.
@[Take Control] holds the last Gig when they attack back.
descSections.combos:
@[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] - cheap Programs and a replay from the trash every turn.
@[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] + value-pair - readies Alt and @[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie]; two Alt uses in a turn.
@[Towerfall] - clears the field when your Street Cred is lower.
@[Trust No One] + @[Peace Offering] - the min Gigs everything runs on.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep @[Trust No One] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire] with a cheap answer and a card to sell.
Two or more of @[Towerfall] and @[Les Élémens] in one hand should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Trust No One] with a Call, then @[Peace Offering] or @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy].
High-cost Programs in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Take Control], @[Floor It] or @[Chrome Reverie] for their first attack, with @[Trust No One] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire].
descSections.notes:
Keep the d4 at 1 and never swap it away; @[Pyramid Song] checks the d4.
@[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] only bottom-decks unequipped Units.
@[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie] triggers only on @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy], @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy], @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] and @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide].

descSections.overview: A Gear deck built around @[Panam Palmer: Nomad Cavalry|Panam]: Gear goes on the Legend first, then moves to a Unit to ready it for a second attack. @[Overwatch: Panam's Gift|Overwatch] is the Gear that matters most, removing spent Units at Quick speed wherever it sits. @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] readies Panam and @[Jackie Welles: Mama's Favorite|Jackie] so the trick repeats. A casual list that wins at locals.
descSections.early:
Aim is Units on curve with cheap Gear: @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] or @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] with @[Mantis Blades] or @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori].
Call @[Panam Palmer: Nomad Cavalry|Panam] as soon as it is found; @[Panam Palmer: Strength Through Family|Panam STF] Calls for free once it is on the field.
Sell @[Industrial Assembly] and the extra @[Synapse Burnout] first.
@[Peace Offering] early builds the value-pair @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] needs.
descSections.mid:
Aim is Gear on @[Panam Palmer: Nomad Cavalry|Panam] then moved: @[Overwatch: Panam's Gift|Overwatch] or @[Sandevistan] on the Legend, then onto a Unit that already attacked so it attacks again.
@[Panam Palmer: Strength Through Family|Panam STF] attacks, discards 1 and draws for each face-up Legend; two attacks in a turn is a full hand.
Look for @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] with a value-pair: Panam and @[Jackie Welles: Mama's Favorite|Jackie] ready and the Gear moves again.
@[Sandayu Oda: Hanako's Guardian|Sandayu Oda] spends a Unit per value-pair on play and attacks Units the same turn.
descSections.late:
Aim is to clear and steal in one turn: @[(Don't Fear) The Reaper|The Reaper] spends everything and defeats one, @[Wild in the Streets] takes the expensive one, then the readied Units take the Gigs.
@[Overwatch: Panam's Gift|Overwatch] with a 5-cost card to discard answers almost any spent Unit.
@[Sandevistan] Units attack every turn and still stand ready to block.
@[Jackie Welles: Mama's Favorite|Jackie] takes the hit for a Unit you cannot lose, or comes down as an 8-power attacker to close.
descSections.combos:
@[Panam Palmer: Nomad Cavalry|Panam] + @[Overwatch: Panam's Gift|Overwatch] - removal at Quick speed on the Legend, then moved to a Unit for a second attack.
@[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] + @[Peace Offering] - the value-pair readies Panam and @[Jackie Welles: Mama's Favorite|Jackie], so the move costs almost nothing.
@[Panam Palmer: Strength Through Family|Panam STF] + @[Sandevistan] - attack, draw, ready, repeat.
@[(Don't Fear) The Reaper|The Reaper] + @[Sandayu Oda: Hanako's Guardian|Sandayu Oda] - the big removal; everything else can be sold.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a 4-cost Unit, a cheap Gear and @[Peace Offering] or @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro].
A hand of @[(Don't Fear) The Reaper|The Reaper], @[Sandayu Oda: Hanako's Guardian|Sandayu Oda] and @[Nadia: Fighting Through Grief|Nadia] with nothing cheap should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Mantis Blades] or @[Peace Offering] with a Call, then @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout].
High-cost Units in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] or @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] on curve with a Gear to follow; @[Synapse Burnout] is worth keeping for the first fight.
descSections.sideboard:
@[Valentino Street Racer] in for @[Industrial Assembly] against Blue decks; attacking the turn a Unit lands beats their bottom-deck Programs.
@[Detonate] in for @[Synapse Burnout] against Gear decks.
The extra @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout], @[Nadia: Fighting Through Grief|Nadia] and @[Synapse Burnout] come in for @[Industrial Assembly] and a @[Wild in the Streets] against Red and Yellow fight decks.
descSections.notes:
Weak to Blue bottom-deck removal; @[Jackie Welles: Mama's Favorite|Jackie] only saves a Unit from being defeated.
@[Overwatch: Panam's Gift|Overwatch] on a Legend is hard for the rival to remove.
Based on the video linked above.

descSections.overview: A Midrange deck with three Fixer Legends: every Call is a choice between a draw and a tempo play, and every Spend adjusts a Gig. Sturdy bodies carry @[Mantis Blades], @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori] and @[Riot Shield]; @[Synapse Burnout] wins the fights and @[NetWatch Netdriver] on a Legend keeps the cards coming.
descSections.early:
Aim is a body with Gear by the second turn: @[Psycho Squad] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] with @[Mantis Blades].
@[NetWatch Netdriver] on the first face-up Legend is a card every turn.
@[Riot Shield] turns @[Psycho Squad] into a 7-power Blocker.
Sell the extra @[Floor It] first and @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] until the fixer area empties.
descSections.mid:
Aim is to attack spent Units and win: @[Memory Relapse] spends their best Unit and keeps it spent, @[Synapse Burnout] adds up to 3 power in the fight, @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori] draws on the win.
@[Padre: Man of the Cross|Padre]'s Call spends a Unit when @[Memory Relapse] is not in hand; @[Wakako Okada: Peace and Harmony|Wakako]'s Call takes 2 power off their attacker.
@[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] wins a fight, readies and attacks again.
@[MaxTac AV]'s swap takes their best Gig.
descSections.late:
Aim is steals from an 8-power attacker every turn: @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] or @[MaxTac AV] with Gear, while @[Riot Shield] Blockers hold your Gigs.
@[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] at 1 €$ is draw 2 or a lock.
@[Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid|Dexter]'s Spend grows your Gigs and @[Wakako Okada: Peace and Harmony|Wakako]'s shrinks theirs; @[Padre: Man of the Cross|Padre]'s Spend sets their biggest Gig to your smallest value.
descSections.combos:
@[Memory Relapse] + @[Synapse Burnout] - spend their Unit, attack it, win the fight with 3 extra power, draw with @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori].
@[NetWatch Netdriver] on a Legend - a card for the Eddie you spend every turn.
@[Psycho Squad] + @[Riot Shield] - a 7-power Blocker that taxes their Go Solo.
@[Padre: Man of the Cross|Padre]'s Spend - sets their biggest Gig to your smallest value.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a 4-cost body, a cheap Gear and one of @[Memory Relapse] or @[Synapse Burnout].
A hand of @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny], @[MaxTac AV] and @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] with no body under 5 should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Mantis Blades] or @[Synapse Burnout] with a Call, then @[Psycho Squad] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout].
High-cost Units in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] or @[Psycho Squad] with @[Riot Shield] or @[Floor It] for their first attack.
descSections.sideboard:
@[Detonate] in for @[Floor It] against Gear decks.
@[Valentino Street Racer] and @[Field Operator] in for @[Riot Shield] against Blue decks, where attacking fast beats their removal.
@[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide], @[Nadia: Fighting Through Grief|Nadia] and the third @[MaxTac AV] in for @[6th Street Recruits] against slow decks that let you reach 8 Eddies.
descSections.notes:
@[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] has no MERC Legend to ready here; it is a 6-power body for 4.
@[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] recovers a card whenever they touch your Gigs.
Pick the Call mode for the field, not the draw, when they have a ready attacker.

descSections.overview: Built to beat the Blue Program decks: big bodies that survive their power loss, Gear on every Unit so their Maman Brigitte cannot touch them, and card flow from the trash with @[All is Lost] and @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu]. @[Animals Wrecker] steals two a turn and @[Adam Smasher: Ender of Legends|Adam Smasher] closes the game.
descSections.early:
Aim is a Blocker and a growing Gig: @[Augmented Negotiators] with @[Mantis Blades], @[Industrial Assembly] on the d4 or d6.
@[All is Lost] finds the Unit the hand is missing and fills the trash for @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu].
Sell the extra @[Zetatech Faceplate] and @[Appetite for Destruction] first; keep @[Industrial Assembly] for the 8+ draw.
Call @[V: Streetkid|V] when @[Bonnie and Clyde] or @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] is missing.
descSections.mid:
Aim is Gear on every Unit; an equipped @[Rockn' Rockerboy] or @[Animals Wrecker] shrugs off their -4 and -5 effects and stays out of reach of their bottom-deck Units.
@[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] with @[Animals Wrecker] on the field defeats anything they play, and 8+ Gigs make it cheap.
@[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] brings @[Augmented Negotiators] back from the trash to attack their spent Unit.
@[Dum Dum: Maelstrom Triggerman|Dum Dum]'s Call trades a spare Gear for two cards.
descSections.late:
Aim is two Gigs per attack from @[Animals Wrecker]; @[Appetite for Destruction] adds a steal when it wins a fight by 3 or more.
@[Adam Smasher: Ender of Legends|Adam Smasher] defeats their last Blocker on the way in and attacks the same turn.
@[Over the Edge] with a high d20 removes anything; @[Dum Dum: Maelstrom Triggerman|Dum Dum]'s Quick pump wins a fight on their turn.
@[6th Street Recruits] turns a stolen d6 into a Gig at 8 or more.
descSections.combos:
@[Animals Wrecker] + @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] - a 10-power Unit makes Carnage hit everything.
@[Appetite for Destruction] + @[Animals Wrecker] - attack a spent Unit, win by 3, steal a Gig as well.
@[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] + @[All is Lost] - the trash becomes a second hand of free Units.
@[Adam Smasher: Ender of Legends|Adam Smasher] - removal and a 9-power attacker in one Call.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a Blocker, a cheap Gear and @[Industrial Assembly] or @[All is Lost].
A hand of @[Animals Wrecker], @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] and @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] with nothing cheap should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[All is Lost], @[Industrial Assembly] or @[Mantis Blades] with a Call, then @[Augmented Negotiators].
High-cost Units in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Augmented Negotiators] ready before their first attack and @[Bonnie and Clyde] for their first body.
descSections.notes:
Against Blue, keep Gear on every Unit; their bottom-deck Units only hit unequipped targets.
Growing your Gigs feeds @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] and @[Industrial Assembly] but also makes their Towerfall stronger; grow them when the payoff is in hand.
@[Rockn' Rockerboy] and @[Animals Wrecker] are here for raw power; they survive -4 and -5 effects where 5-power Units do not.

descSections.overview: A Gear deck built against Blue: Gear on every Unit, @[Industrial Assembly] and @[La Llorona: Ghost of the Past|La Llorona] push Gigs to 8 so @[Johnny Silverhand: Rocking Renegade|Johnny]'s ability becomes free, and fresh Units attack spent Units the turn they land. @[Trauma Team Operatives] and @[The Heist] turn a full trash into cheap bodies and Gear.
descSections.early:
Aim is a Blocker with Gear and a Gig at 8: @[La Llorona: Ghost of the Past|La Llorona] with @[Mantis Blades], @[Industrial Assembly] on the d8 or bigger.
@[The Heist] and @[All is Lost] fill the trash and find Gear or a Unit; @[Trauma Team Operatives] gets cheaper with every Unit in it.
Sell the extra @[Zetatech Faceplate] and @[Mandibular Upgrade] first.
Call @[V: Streetkid|V] for @[Bonnie and Clyde] or @[Industrial Assembly] from the trash.
descSections.mid:
Aim is @[Johnny Silverhand: Rocking Renegade|Johnny]'s ability every turn: a new Unit attacks their spent Unit the turn it lands, with 2 more power if it is @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny NSF].
@[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] drops @[Mantis Blades] or @[Zetatech Faceplate] onto a Blocker during their attack.
@[La Llorona: Ghost of the Past|La Llorona] blocks and grows a Gig by 3 on the way.
@[Viktor Vektor: You Might Feel a Little Pinch|Viktor] brings a Cyberware back from the trash onto another Unit.
descSections.late:
Aim is steals from @[V: Roamer of the Badlands|V Roamer] and @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny NSF]: every stolen Gig grows by 5 and two Gigs at 8+ draw a card each turn.
@[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] replays @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] or @[La Llorona: Ghost of the Past|La Llorona] from the trash as a free attacker.
@[Bonnie and Clyde] clears two Units when they are 2 Gigs ahead.
@[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] gets a card back every time they swap or adjust your Gigs.
descSections.combos:
@[Johnny Silverhand: Rocking Renegade|Johnny] + 8+ Gigs - the ability costs nothing, so every Unit attacks the turn it is played.
@[The Heist] + @[Trauma Team Operatives] - the trash fills, the 7-power body costs 1 or 2.
@[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] + @[Mantis Blades] - a free Gear in the React Step that flips a fight.
@[V: Roamer of the Badlands|V Roamer] - every steal becomes a big Gig and a draw.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a cheap Unit, a cheap Gear and @[Industrial Assembly] or @[The Heist].
A hand of @[Trauma Team Operatives], @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] and @[V: Roamer of the Badlands|V Roamer] with nothing cheap should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Mantis Blades], @[Industrial Assembly] or @[The Heist] with a Call, then @[La Llorona: Ghost of the Past|La Llorona].
High-cost Units in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[La Llorona: Ghost of the Past|La Llorona] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] ready before their first attack, with a Gear to hold for @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward].
descSections.notes:
Keep Gear on every Unit against Blue; their bottom-deck Units only hit unequipped targets.
@[Johnny Silverhand: Rocking Renegade|Johnny]'s ability still needs the Spend even at 0 €$, so plan the Legend Eddies around it.
@[The Heist] plays the found Gear for free when its cost matches one of your Gig values; a Gig at 1 or 2 makes that common.

descSections.overview: A Control deck that empties the rival's field with Programs, then steals with a small number of Units. The aim is to get your Gigs to 1. Min Gigs make Programs cheaper through @[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt], give @[Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor|Hanako] and @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe] their value-pairs, and keep your Street Cred low for @[Towerfall]. Alt replays the best Program from the trash, so the removal never runs out.
descSections.early:
The aim is a d4 at 1 as soon as possible. @[Trust No One] gets it there and draws a card on the way.
Next aim is a value-pair of min Gigs. @[Peace Offering] sets the second Gig to match the first and draws when it does.
Call a Legend each turn. @[Chrome Reverie] is a free Call once a min Gig is in place, so it is the best Call when a rival attacker also needs stopping.
Programs to sell first: extra @[Floor It], extra @[Take Control], and a @[Les Élémens] when @[Towerfall] is already in hand.
@[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy] is the early body. It attacks on any turn a Program was played, which is nearly every turn.
descSections.mid:
The aim is to clear the field in one turn. Spend @[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt] for the discount, then @[Towerfall] with lower Street Cred than the rival so everything at 5 power or less goes to the bottom of their deck.
Against one large Unit, look for @[Floor It] and @[Pyramid Song] in the same turn as @[Towerfall]. Together they bring anything to 0.
Single targets go to @[Les Élémens] or @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte]. Look for @[Valentino Street Racer] with Maman so Maman bottom-decks a Unit and attacks in the same turn.
Look for @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] with a value-pair. The attack readies Alt and @[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie], so Alt can replay @[Towerfall] or @[Les Élémens] from the trash that same turn.
Keep new Gigs at 1 as they arrive. @[Trust No One] handles the small dice, @[Peace Offering] handles the d20.
descSections.late:
@[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] is the draw engine once the fixer area is empty, or a lock on their only attacker.
Attack the Gig area every turn with @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe], @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman] and the @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boys]. Steal their low Gigs, not the d20. A low Street Cred keeps @[Towerfall] at full strength, and only the count matters.
@[Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor|Hanako]'s swap gives back a high Gig you took in exchange for a low one, or builds another value-pair for extra draws.
@[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt]'s replays go to the bottom of your deck. That is the answer when the deck gets thin from all the drawing.
descSections.combos:
@[Alt Cunningham: Soulkiller Architect|Alt Cunningham] - the engine. Cheaper Programs from min Gigs and a Program back from the trash every turn.
@[Trust No One] and @[Peace Offering] - the fuel. Every min Gig is a discount, a draw, and a value-pair.
@[Towerfall] - the board clear. With lower Street Cred it removes the whole rival field.
@[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] - the attacker that readies Alt and @[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie] for a second Alt use.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep @[Trust No One] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire] with one cheap defensive Program and a Program to sell.
High-cost Programs and Units in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Trust No One], one of @[Three Mouths, One Desire] or @[Peace Offering], and one cheap defensive Program such as @[Chrome Reverie] or @[Take Control].
A hand built around @[Towerfall], @[Les Élémens] and @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] is a mulligan.
descSections.mulliganSecond:
Look for @[Trust No One] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire], plus @[Take Control], @[Floor It] or @[Chrome Reverie] for the rival's first attack, plus a Program to sell.
The rival attacks first, so a hand with Gig pieces but no Quick Program or @[Chrome Reverie] is a mulligan. Two or more copies of @[Towerfall] or @[Les Élémens] is also a mulligan.
descSections.notes:
Keep the d4 at 1 and never swap it away. @[Pyramid Song] checks the d4 specifically.
@[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie Welles] triggers on @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy] and @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] only. It is mainly an Eddie and a Pepe ready target.
@[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] only bottom-decks unequipped Units. @[Les Élémens] and @[Towerfall] handle Gear-heavy targets.

descSections.overview: A Control deck where every Braindance Program is both removal and a power boost through @[Judy Álvarez: Braindance Maestro|Judy]. Cheap draw Programs fuel min Gigs, @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] replays the best Program from the trash, and @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] or @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] send the rival's Units to the bottom of their deck.
descSections.early:
Aim is a d4 at 1 and then a value-pair. @[Trust No One] and @[Peace Offering] get there and draw on the way.
@[Delamain: Rideshare AI|Delamain] is the early play when the hand is thin; @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy] when it is not.
Sell the extra @[Floor It] and @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] first. @[Les Élémens] is a sell only when @[Pyramid Song] and @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] are already in hand.
Spend @[Judy Álvarez: Braindance Maestro|Judy] for a Program off the top whenever the Eddie is not needed.
descSections.mid:
Aim is to answer each attacker the turn it lands: @[Chrome Reverie] locks it, @[Pyramid Song] shrinks it or bottom-decks it, @[Memory Relapse] spends it and keeps it spent.
Look for @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] with a Program already in the trash: a free @[Pyramid Song] or @[Chrome Reverie] plus a Blocker.
Stack Braindance Programs in one turn so @[Judy Álvarez: Braindance Maestro|Judy] turns @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy] into a Unit that wins its fight or steals.
descSections.late:
Aim is @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] with Programs to spare: a Unit to the bottom on play, another on each attack, two Gigs per steal.
@[Les Élémens] and @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] clear what is left so the cheap Units can steal.
@[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] is draw 2 for 1 once the fixer area is empty.
Steal low Gigs and keep yours at 1; @[Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor|Hanako] draws for every value-pair and the swap can build one.
descSections.combos:
@[Judy Álvarez: Braindance Maestro|Judy] - every Braindance Program is +1 power, so several in one turn let a small Unit win a fight or push through.
@[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] - a free Program from the trash and a Blocker on one card.
@[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] - the finisher; Programs in hand become bottom-decked rival Units.
@[Trust No One] + @[Peace Offering] - min Gigs and value-pairs that feed @[Three Mouths, One Desire], @[Pyramid Song] and @[Hanako Arasaka: Daughter of the Emperor|Hanako].
descSections.mulligan:
Keep two or three cheap Programs with a cheap Unit or one removal Program.
A hand of @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide], @[Les Élémens] and @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] with no 1-cost Program should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Trust No One] with a Call on the first turn, then @[Delamain: Rideshare AI|Delamain] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire].
High-cost cards in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond:
Look for @[Trust No One] or @[Three Mouths, One Desire] plus an answer to the first attacker: @[Floor It], @[Chrome Reverie] or @[Pyramid Song].
One @[Les Élémens] is fine when two cheap plays carry you to it.
descSections.notes:
@[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] only bottom-decks unequipped Units; Gear-heavy targets go to @[Les Élémens] or @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide].
@[Jackie Welles: Pour One Out For Me|Jackie] triggers on Blue Units only: @[Jacked-In Voodoo Boy|Voodoo Boy], @[Delamain: Rideshare AI|Delamain], @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy], @[Maman Brigitte: Spirit of Death|Maman Brigitte] and @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide].
With many cards in hand, sell the second copy of a removal Program rather than a draw Program.

Gear-equipped @[Psycho Squad] and @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] win fights with @[Synapse Burnout]; @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] and @[Nadia: Fighting Through Grief|Nadia] close, and @[Chrome Reverie], @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] and @[Memory Relapse] hold the rival in place.

Sell the extra @[Floor It] and @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] first.

descSections.combos:
@[Valentino Street Racer] + @[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] - a 6-power attack the turn it lands.
@[Memory Relapse] + @[Synapse Burnout] - spend their Unit, attack it, win with up to 3 extra power.
@[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] - a Blocker that replays the lock or removal Program you need.
@[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] - the finisher once Programs are spare.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a 3 or 4-cost body, a cheap Gear and one of @[Chrome Reverie], @[Floor It] or @[Memory Relapse].
A hand of @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide], @[Nadia: Fighting Through Grief|Nadia] and @[Over the Edge] with no cheap body should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Mantis Blades] or @[Synapse Burnout] with a Call, then @[Valentino Street Racer] or @[Psycho Squad].
High-cost Units in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Psycho Squad] or @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] as the first Blocker and @[Floor It] or @[Chrome Reverie] for their first attack.
descSections.notes:
@[Pepe Najarro: Working Doubles|Pepe Najarro] has no MERC Legend to ready here; it is a 6-power body for 4.
@[Valentino Street Racer] only reaches Units with cost 5 or less, so not @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] or @[Nadia: Fighting Through Grief|Nadia].
@[Wakako Okada: Peace and Harmony|Wakako]'s Call takes 2 power off an attacker during the React Step.

descSections.overview: A Control deck in Red and Blue: @[V: Streetkid|V] and @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] turn the trash into a second hand of Braindance Programs, @[Industrial Assembly] pushes Gigs to 8 so @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] is cheap, and @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] and @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] finish on a cleared field.
descSections.early:
Aim is a Gear-equipped body and a Gig at 8: @[Psycho Squad] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] with @[Mantis Blades], @[Industrial Assembly] on the first big die.
@[Chrome Reverie] locks their first attacker and Calls for free with a Gig at 1; @[Wakako Okada: Peace and Harmony|Wakako]'s Spend makes one.
Sell the extra @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] and @[6th Street Recruits] first.
Call @[V: Streetkid|V] when the hand lacks removal; @[Bonnie and Clyde], @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage], @[Chrome Reverie] and @[Industrial Assembly] all come back from the trash.
descSections.mid:
Aim is to answer each Unit for less than they paid: @[Bonnie and Clyde] at 4 power or less, @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] while a bigger friendly Unit stands, @[Over the Edge] as the d20 climbs.
@[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] replays @[Bonnie and Clyde], @[Over the Edge] or @[Chrome Reverie] from the trash and blocks.
@[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] brings @[Psycho Squad] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] back to attack their spent Unit the same turn.
@[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori] on the Unit that fights most keeps the hand full.
descSections.late:
Aim is @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] or @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] attacking an empty field; Placide takes two Gigs and bottom-decks a Unit per attack with a spare Program.
@[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] at 1 €$ is draw 2 every turn.
@[Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid|Dexter]'s Spend grows the Gigs for @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] and @[Industrial Assembly]'s draw.
@[Over the Edge] with the d20 high answers whatever they rebuild.
descSections.combos:
@[V: Streetkid|V] + @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] - the trash is a second hand; V finds the Braindance, Lizzy plays it free.
@[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] + @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] or @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] - a 9 or 10-power Unit on the field makes Carnage hit anything.
@[Industrial Assembly] + @[Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid|Dexter] - Gigs at 8 draw cards and discount Carnage.
@[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] - a free Unit from the trash that attacks immediately.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a 4-cost body, @[Mantis Blades] and one of @[Industrial Assembly], @[Chrome Reverie] or @[Bonnie and Clyde].
A hand of @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide], @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] and @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] with nothing cheap should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Industrial Assembly] or @[Mantis Blades] with a Call, then @[Psycho Squad] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout].
High-cost cards in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] or @[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] before their first attack, with @[Bonnie and Clyde] or @[Chrome Reverie] for their first body.
descSections.notes:
@[Wakako Okada: Peace and Harmony|Wakako]'s Spend works against the Red plan when used on your own Gigs; use it on theirs or to make a Gig at 1 for @[Chrome Reverie].
@[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] compares power, so a @[Mantis Blades] on your biggest Unit widens its reach.
@[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] needs a Program in hand to bottom-deck; hold one back instead of selling it.

descSections.overview: A Midrange deck that grows its Gigs and cashes them in: @[V: Roamer of the Badlands|V Roamer] turns every steal into a Gig at 8 or more, @[Industrial Assembly] and @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] get better with each one, and @[Over the Edge] with a high d20 answers anything. @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] replays the cheap Units from the trash.
descSections.early:
Aim is a Blocker with Gear and a Gig on the way to 8: @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] with @[Mantis Blades], @[Industrial Assembly] on the first big die.
Sell @[Detonate] when they show no Gear and the extra @[Zetatech Faceplate].
Call @[V: Streetkid|V] when @[Bonnie and Clyde] or @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] is missing.
@[Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid|Dexter]'s Spend adds 2 to a Gig whenever the Eddie is spare.
descSections.mid:
Aim is @[V: Roamer of the Badlands|V Roamer] stealing every turn: each stolen Gig grows by 5 and two Gigs at 8+ draw a card each turn.
@[Bonnie and Clyde] on anything at 4 power or less, @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] while @[Animals Wrecker] stands, @[Over the Edge] as the d20 climbs.
Look for @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] with @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] in the trash: a free attacker on their spent Unit.
@[Muamar Reyes: El Capitán|Muamar Reyes]'s Call lets a Blocker take the hit and survive.
descSections.late:
Aim is two Gigs per attack: @[Animals Wrecker] with @[Mantis Blades] or @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori].
@[6th Street Recruits] turns a stolen d6 into a Gig at 8 or more.
@[Over the Edge] with the d20 at 15 or more removes their last Blocker for the final steal.
@[Augmented Negotiators] stays ready as the Blocker that also strips their hand.
descSections.combos:
@[V: Roamer of the Badlands|V Roamer] + @[Industrial Assembly] - Gigs at 8 that draw, discount @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] and feed @[Over the Edge].
@[Animals Wrecker] + @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] - a 10-power Unit makes Carnage hit anything.
@[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] - a free Unit from the trash that attacks the same turn.
@[Over the Edge] - the late game answer to any Unit.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a Blocker, a cheap Gear and @[Industrial Assembly] or @[Bonnie and Clyde].
A hand of @[Animals Wrecker], @[Yorinobu Arasaka: Steel Dragon|Yorinobu] and @[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] with nothing cheap should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Industrial Assembly] or @[Mantis Blades] with a Call, then @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout].
High-cost Units in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] ready before their first attack, plus @[Bonnie and Clyde].
descSections.notes:
@[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] gets a card back whenever they swap or adjust your Gigs; against Gig-swapping Legends it is the first Unit to play.
@[Bonnie and Clyde] defeats two Units when they are 2 Gigs ahead; hold it while behind.
@[Carnage at the Colosseum|Carnage] compares power, so a @[Mantis Blades] on your biggest Unit widens its reach.

descSections.overview: A Gear deck that cheats @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] into play: a Unit wearing @[The Relic: Experimental Biochip|The Relic] is defeated, @[Live with the Aftermath] does it on demand, and Placide comes back from the trash for free. @[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler], @[The Heist] and @[Tetratronic Rippler] put Placide in the trash early; @[NetWatch Netdriver] on a Legend keeps the cards coming.
descSections.early:
Aim is a Blocker with @[The Relic: Experimental Biochip|The Relic] on it and a @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] in the trash: @[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler] discards it, @[The Heist] mills it, @[Tetratronic Rippler] trashes it off the top.
@[NetWatch Netdriver] on the first face-up Legend is a card every turn.
Sell @[Bootleg Black Sapphire Show|Bootleg] and the extra @[Chrome Reverie] first; keep @[Live with the Aftermath].
@[Augmented Negotiators] holds the field and strips a card when it blocks.
descSections.mid:
Aim is the Relic turn: @[Live with the Aftermath] defeats your own Relic Unit, @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] lands free from the trash and bottom-decks their Unit, and the Relic Unit goes to the bottom of your deck to be drawn again.
@[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] drops @[Zetatech Faceplate] or @[Adrenaline Converter] onto a Unit during their attack; a Blocker with Gear that dies also filters the top of the deck.
@[Lizzy Wizzy: Delicate Weapon|Lizzy Wizzy] replays @[Live with the Aftermath], @[Chrome Reverie] or @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] free.
@[Chrome Reverie] and @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] lock their attacker while the pieces assemble.
descSections.late:
Aim is @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] attacking every turn with a Program to discard: two Gigs per steal and a Unit to the bottom each time.
@[Adrenaline Converter] on Placide lets it attack the turn it lands when they are 2 Gigs ahead.
@[Rogue Amendiares: Preem Solo|Rogue] and @[V: Corporate Exile|V] come down through Go Solo to close; @[Nocturne OP55 N1|Nocturne] takes 2 off the price.
@[Rogue Amendiares: Preem Solo|Rogue] draws or strips a card whenever a Legend steals.
descSections.combos:
@[The Relic: Experimental Biochip|The Relic] + @[Live with the Aftermath] - defeat your own Unit, play @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] for free.
@[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler] - the Blocker that puts Placide in the trash with its first spend.
@[NetWatch Netdriver] on a Legend - a card for the Eddie you spend every turn.
@[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] - the finisher; every Program in hand is another Unit sent to the bottom.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a Blocker, @[The Relic: Experimental Biochip|The Relic] or @[The Heist], and a Program to sell.
A hand of three @[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] with no way to trash one should go back; one Placide in hand is fine when @[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler] is there to discard it.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Tetratronic Rippler] or @[The Heist] with a Call, then @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler].
High-cost cards in the opening hand are not ideal, apart from one Placide you can discard.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Augmented Negotiators] or @[Rita Wheeler: No Stupid Questions|Rita Wheeler] before their first attack, and @[Chrome Reverie] for their first body.
descSections.notes:
@[The Relic: Experimental Biochip|The Relic] triggers on any defeat, including a lost block, so the Relic Unit can be the Blocker.
@[Live with the Aftermath] with no friendly Unit removes one of theirs for nothing; they pick which.
@[Placide: Voodoo Sentinel|Placide] from the trash still needs a Program in hand to bottom-deck; hold one back.

descSections.overview: A Gear deck: cheap Cyberware on cheap Units, played at Quick speed through @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] so fights are won in the React Step. @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] with @[Gorilla Arms] is the finisher: win a fight, ready, then take two Gigs.
descSections.early:
Aim is a Unit with Gear by the second turn: @[Swordwise Huscle] or @[Secondhand Bombus] with @[Mantis Blades] or @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori].
@[Swordwise Huscle] with @[Mantis Blades] draws on every attack.
Sell @[Bootleg Black Sapphire Show|Bootleg] early and @[Live with the Aftermath] when your field is the bigger one.
Hold one cheap Gear for @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] during their attack.
descSections.mid:
Aim is to win fights, not just steal: @[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori] draws on every win, @[Dexter DeShawn: Off the Grid|Dexter]'s Call adds 2 power, @[Muamar Reyes: El Capitán|Muamar Reyes]'s Call makes a Unit survive its fight.
Look for @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] plus @[Mantis Blades] on a Blocker in the React Step so their attacker dies.
@[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] is the Blocker that beats Legends; @[Secondhand Bombus] is the one you do not mind losing.
@[Live with the Aftermath] trades a @[Secondhand Bombus] for a Unit of theirs; strongest when they have only one.
descSections.late:
Aim is @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] with @[Gorilla Arms]: win a fight against a spent Unit, ready, then take two Gigs from the Gig area.
@[Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom|Jackie Welles] with even Gigs is another two-Gig attacker; @[Zetatech Faceplate] sets the values up.
@[Adrenaline Converter] lets a fresh Unit attack when they are 2 Gigs ahead.
@[Over the Edge] with a high d20 removes the last Blocker.
descSections.combos:
@[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] + @[Gorilla Arms] - win, ready, steal two.
@[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] + @[Mantis Blades] - a free Gear in the React Step that flips a fight.
@[Swordwise Huscle] + any 2-power Gear - a 3-cost Unit that draws every time it attacks.
@[Satori: Sword of Saburo|Satori] - the deck's card draw; put it on the Unit that fights the most.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep two cheap Units and two cheap Gear.
A hand with no Unit under 4, or Gear with nothing to equip, should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Mantis Blades] or @[Secondhand Bombus] with a Call on the first turn and @[Swordwise Huscle] after.
@[Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom|Jackie Welles] and @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Meredith Stout: Stone Cold Corpo|Meredith Stout] or @[Secondhand Bombus] plus a Gear to answer their first attacker in the React Step.
descSections.notes:
@[Gorilla Arms] takes a Gig whose value you do not already hold, so vary your own Gig values with @[Zetatech Faceplate].
@[6th Street Recruits] grows a Gig by 6 whenever a stolen Gig is a d6; take their d6 first when it is there.
@[Muamar Reyes: El Capitán|Muamar Reyes]'s Spend adjusts a Gig by 1 for the @[Jackie Welles: Ride or Die Choom|Jackie Welles] even count.

descSections.overview: A Gear deck that recycles its Cyberware: @[The Heist] and @[All is Lost] fill the trash, @[Viktor Vektor: You Might Feel a Little Pinch|Viktor] and @[Dum Dum: Maelstrom Triggerman|Dum Dum] turn Gear in the trash into cards and power, and @[Trauma Team Operatives] gets cheap. @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] with @[Gorilla Arms] takes two Gigs per attack.
descSections.early:
Aim is a cheap Unit wearing cheap Gear: @[Swordwise Huscle] or @[Secondhand Bombus] with @[Mantis Blades] or @[Zetatech Faceplate].
@[The Heist] finds a Gear and fills the trash; @[All is Lost] finds a Unit and does the same.
Sell the extra @[Mandibular Upgrade] and @[Adrenaline Converter] first.
@[Swordwise Huscle] with @[Mantis Blades] draws on every attack.
descSections.mid:
Aim is Gear from the trash: @[Viktor Vektor: You Might Feel a Little Pinch|Viktor] replays @[Mantis Blades], @[Zetatech Faceplate] or @[Adrenaline Converter] onto another Unit for free.
@[Dum Dum: Maelstrom Triggerman|Dum Dum]'s Call trades a Gear for two cards, and @[Viktor Vektor: You Might Feel a Little Pinch|Viktor] brings the Gear back.
@[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] drops @[Mandibular Upgrade] onto a Unit during their attack for a surprise Blocker, or @[Mantis Blades] to win the fight.
@[Trauma Team Operatives] lands for 1 or 2 once the trash holds a few Units.
descSections.late:
Aim is @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] with @[Gorilla Arms]: win a fight against a spent Unit, ready, then take two Gigs.
@[Dum Dum: Maelstrom Triggerman|Dum Dum]'s Quick pump on a Unit with three Gear wins any fight on either turn.
@[V: Streetkid|V] comes down through Go Solo as another body for the Gear.
@[6th Street Recruits] turns a stolen d6 into a Gig at 8 or more.
descSections.combos:
@[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] + @[Gorilla Arms] - win, ready, steal two.
@[Dum Dum: Maelstrom Triggerman|Dum Dum] + @[Viktor Vektor: You Might Feel a Little Pinch|Viktor] - defeat a Gear for two cards, then replay it for free.
@[The Heist] + @[Trauma Team Operatives] - the trash fills, the 7-power body costs almost nothing.
@[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] + @[Mandibular Upgrade] - a Blocker out of nowhere during their attack.
descSections.mulligan:
Keep a cheap Unit, two cheap Gear and @[The Heist] or @[All is Lost].
A hand of @[Trauma Team Operatives], @[Johnny Silverhand: Never Stop Fighting|Johnny] and @[Gorilla Arms] with no cheap Unit should go back.
descSections.mulliganFirst:
Look for @[Mantis Blades] or @[The Heist] with a Call, then @[Swordwise Huscle] or @[Secondhand Bombus].
High-cost Units in the opening hand are not ideal.
descSections.mulliganSecond: Look for @[Secondhand Bombus] or @[Swordwise Huscle] with a Gear held for @[River Ward: Detective on the Hunt|River Ward] during their first attack.
descSections.notes:
@[Viktor Vektor: You Might Feel a Little Pinch|Viktor] only equips the returned Gear to another Unit, so have a second body first.
@[Gorilla Arms] takes a Gig whose value you do not already hold; @[Zetatech Faceplate] keeps your values spread.
@[Adrenaline Converter] only works while they are 2 Gigs ahead.
